title: Yoshi Topsy-Turvy
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 12820 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text:
Tilt the world to roll things and move Yoshi
Tilt the cartridge (gyro sensor; mapped to buttons in emulators) to roll Yoshi, boulders and platforms

Bosses at chapter ends
Bosses at the end of chapters; tilting moves them too

Coins, fruit
Coins and fruit; Egglings (Safari, Ref, Cocoa and others) appear in the game

Each chapter has goals; medals for clearing them
Medal goals are shown at the start of each chapter

Chapters cleared
Chapters in a storybook; minigames keep high scores (Shuffle, Pirate Battle, Big Jump, Time Attack)
